pages.text: Fictional test profile only. We manage properties and coordinate maintenance reports. We do not promise attendance or completion dates.

Fictional test profile only. Invoices are payable within 14 days by bank transfer. Estimates require written landlord approval.
Fictional test profile only. We agree the address, intended start date, authority, scope and fees in writing. A signed agreement and handover are required before the start date is confirmed.
Fictional test profile only. We provide monthly service and landlord updates. Inspection intervals follow the agreement. We track completion and check repeat reports.

Fictional test profile only. Maintenance reports include property, issue, urgency, photos and access. We distinguish stated facts from inference and ask for missing details. We do not diagnose or promise a visit. Written approval and authority must be checked. We do not make a legal determination from an email. Urgent safety guidance must not wait for an approval request.
Fictional test profile only. We do not provide diagnosis or emergency dispatch through this site or BLAM8. There is no staffed out-of-hours repair service.

Fictional test profile only. Our office hours are Monday to Friday, 09:00–17:00 UK time, excluding public holidays. Routine reports are reviewed next working day. Our service area is Camden, Islington, Hackney and Haringey; we check the postcode before agreeing coverage.
